points: What exactly does an examiner want when a question says 'explain'?

panels.title: Islamic foundation
panels.text: Allah says: 'We have certainly created the human being in the best of forms' (at-Tin 95:4). Revising how cells and enzymes work is also a reminder of that design.

keywords.def: give a short answer with no explanation
say what happens or what something is like
give reasons: say why or how, using 'because'
organism whose cells have a nucleus
enzyme active site changed so substrate no longer fits

panels.title: Revision: living organisms, cells and enzymes; command words
points: Evaluate: both sides and a judgement

panels.title: Describe and explain the effect of temperature on amylase activity. [4 marks]
points: Describe: activity increases to an optimum of about 40 °C, then falls
Explain rise: more kinetic energy, more successful collisions
Explain fall: active site changes shape, enzyme denatured
Substrate no longer fits, so rate falls to zero
Answer: One descriptive point and three explanatory points
